Path: ② the capabilities an end user meets in the app — record pages | 缺项 | P2

## Triage: first grade — `enhancement` · `priority:p3` · `domain:ui` · `area:records` · `pm:queue`. The delete confirmation names the record and confirms with a destructive, explicit action

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-06T06:59Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Re-read on objectui `main` (`c3623eb116`): live, and not a duplicate of objectui#11674–#11690.

Triage: lands in `packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx` (about `:3132` and `:3164`), `packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordDetailView.tsx` (about `:2617`), `packages/core/src/actions/recordDelete.ts` (`confirmText`, about `:115`–`:124`) and `packages/components/src/ui/alert-dialog.tsx` (no destructive variant, about `:108`–`:116`) ⇒ `domain:ui`; rationale: the dialog uses generic text and a neutral "Continue".

- **Done when:**
  - The confirmation names the record by its title field and the object label, and the confirm button reads as a deletion ("Delete") in the destructive style, translated in every locale.
  - Both call sites share the one text.
- **Pin:** deleting a named record shows its title and a destructive "Delete" button in en and zh-CN.
